name: Teaching Dimension / Antichain Number
witness_verification: For every n >= 1, the singleton-plus-empty class has teaching dimension n (value 160) and antichain number 1 (value 1161). Their ratio is n and tends to infinity, excluding every reverse affine bound. The ordinary teaching lower bound comes from the empty target; the antichain teacher uses the distinct signed singleton samples {(i,1)} and {(1,0)}.
details: For every finite binary concept class, $\mathrm{TD}(\mathcal H)\geq\mathrm{AN}(\mathcal H)$.
